cases.name: sum_across_three_pages
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "large" | EVAL result = NESTED(SUM(items.price * items.quantity)) | KEEP id, result

cases.name: last_maximum_in_final_page
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "large" | EVAL result = NESTED(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, result

cases.name: last_keeps_maximum_from_first_page
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "early_max" | EVAL result = NESTED(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, result

cases.name: existence_match_in_final_page
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "large" | EVAL result = NESTED(items.active) | KEEP id, result

cases.name: existence_no_match_across_pages
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "large" | EVAL result = NESTED(items.price > 2050) | KEEP id, result

cases.name: all_null_sum_across_pages
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "all_null" | EVAL result = NESTED(SUM(items.price)) | KEEP id, result

cases.name: empty_sum
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "empty" | EVAL result = NESTED(SUM(items.price)) | KEEP id, result

cases.name: explicit_scalar_predicate_across_pages
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "late_invalid" | EVAL result = NESTED(MV_MAX(items.active)) | KEEP id, result

cases.name: late_invalid_predicate_after_matching_page
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "late_invalid" | EVAL result = NESTED(items.active) | KEEP id, result
cases.reason: NESTED existence requires a scalar predicate result per child

cases.name: separate_parent_states
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_paging | WHERE id == "large" OR id == "all_null" | EVAL result = NESTED(SUM(items.price)) | KEEP id, result | SORT id
